title: A k-covector vanishing on (e_{α(0)}, …, e_{α(k−1)}) is annihilated by every linear map whose image lies in span{e_{α(q)}} (supplied step 4d)
statement: Let m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, let α ∈ SimonMultiIndex k m′ (a strictly increasing map α : Fin k → Fin m′), let γ be a k-covector on ℝ^{m′} = Eucl m′ (a continuous alternating k-linear map (ℝ^{m′})^k → ℝ) and let T : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} be a continuous linear map. Write e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 for the standard basis vectors and v_i for the i-th coordinate of v ∈ ℝ^{m′}. Assume γ(e_{α(0)}, …, e_{α(k−1)}) = 0 and (Tv)_i = 0 for every v ∈ ℝ^m and every i ∈ Fin m′ with i ∉ range α. Then the pulled-back covector γ.compContinuousLinearMap T, (v_0, …, v_{k−1}) ↦ γ(Tv_0, …, Tv_{k−1}), is zero.
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (α : SimonMultiIndex k m') (γ : Eucl m' [⋀^Fin k]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (T : Eucl m →L[ℝ] Eucl m'), γ (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (α j) (1 : ℝ)) = 0 → (∀ (v : Eucl m) (i : Fin m'), i ∉ range α → T v i = 0) → γ.compContinuousLinearMap T = 0
